A '''city''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Raxus Secundus/Legends|Raxus Secundus]].

The [[City/Legends|city]] was structured with a circular pattern, and had the [[Separatist Senate Building/Legends|Separatist Senate Building]] complex in the middle. It had a [[Unidentified Raxus Secundus spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] guarded by [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s, who checked any suspicious passengers arriving at the city. The city was the location of the [[Separatist Senate/Legends|Separatist Parliament]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
